Position rule: Place near speaker's head; avoid covering character face or key anchor features; min 8px margin from panel edge
Size rule: Width: 30-50% of panel width; height: 2-4 lines max
Shape & style: Round-rect with smooth tail; border 1.5px solid #333; fill white 90% opacity
Overlap rule: Do not overlap other speech bubbles unless intentional (e.g. characters talking over each other)
Layer priority: Above background elements; below foreground elements; same layer as character if character is midground
Prompt assembly rule: [dialogue text] + [speaker expression at moment of speech] + [gesture accompanying speech if any]
Common failure: Tail points to wrong character; bubble covers face / eyes / hairstyle anchor; text too long (4+ lines); bubble too small causing overflow

Tail direction: No tail or small dashed tail to character's temple/forehead
Position rule: Place upper-left or upper-right of panel; slightly away from character to suggest "voice in head"
Size rule: Width: 20-35% of panel width; height: 1-3 lines
Shape & style: Cloud-shaped or rounded with dashed border; fill light blue or light gray 80% opacity
Overlap rule: May overlap character slightly (10% max) to indicate internal nature; never overlap another bubble
Layer priority: Same layer as standard speech; distinguish by style (dashed vs solid)
Prompt assembly rule: [monologue text] + [character's current facial expression: thoughtful / conflicted / determined] + [optional: eye close-up to emphasize introspection]
Common failure: Confused with standard speech (reader can't tell internal vs external); tail points to mouth instead of temple; too large (looks like narration)

Tail direction: No tail; full-width bar or box
Position rule: Top or bottom of panel; full panel width; 12px margin from edge
Size rule: Full panel width minus margins; height: 1-2 lines max
Shape & style: Rectangular bar with no border; fill black 70% opacity; white text; font smaller than speech
Overlap rule: Must not overlap any character or speech bubble; dedicated top/bottom zone
Layer priority: Top layer (above everything) if at top; bottom layer (below panel art) if at bottom
Prompt assembly rule: [narration: time / place / mood setting] + [optional: environmental sound cue]
Common failure: Overlaps character or action; font too large (competes with art); used excessively (more than 1 per page kills immersion)

Tail direction: No tail; radiates from sound source
Position rule: Centered on or near sound source (impact point / character mouth / object)
Size rule: Varies: large for major sounds (explosion / slam); small for subtle sounds (heartbeat / breath)
Shape & style: Dynamic angular or jagged shape; no fill or light fill; bold font; may be tilted for motion
Overlap rule: May overlap action source or environment element; never overlap character face
Layer priority: Above midground; below foreground; same layer as environmental details
Prompt assembly rule: [SFX text: onomatopoeia] + [sound source: object / action / character] + [optional: motion lines or shock wave radiating from source]
Common failure: SFX placed randomly (reader can't identify sound source); too many SFX per panel (visual noise); font too small or too thin (unreadable)

Tail direction: Small tail to speaker's mouth; additional small radiating lines around bubble edge
Position rule: Close to speaker's mouth; slightly smaller than standard speech; may be partially off-panel for secrecy effect
Size rule: Width: 20-30% of panel width; height: 1-2 lines
Shape & style: Dotted or dashed border; smaller font; light gray fill; may use ellipses
Overlap rule: May overlap listener's ear or face partially to indicate proximity
Prompt assembly rule: [whispered text with ellipses] + [speaker's furtive expression: side-glance / hushed lips] + [listener's reaction: ear turned / surprised eyes]
Common failure: Styled identically to standard speech (reader misses whisper nuance); tail too long (disconnects from mouth); text too long (whispers are brief)

Tail direction: Thick tail to speaker's mouth; jagged edges radiating outward
Position rule: Large and dominant; may break panel border ("burst bubble"); center or upper portion of panel
Size rule: Width: 40-60% of panel width; height: 1-2 lines but very large font
Shape & style: Jagged or starburst shape; thick border 2-3px; fill red or orange gradient; bold italic font
Overlap rule: May overlap character and background partially; intended to dominate the panel
Prompt assembly rule: [shouted text in ALL CAPS] + [speaker's extreme expression: wide eyes / open mouth / veins / tears] + [optional: background motion blur or shock effect]
Common failure: Too small (lacks impact); same style as standard speech; too many words (screams are brief); placed in corner (wastes visual weight)

Tail direction: Small tail to device or earpiece; may have pixelated or screen-like border
Position rule: Near the device (phone / screen / earpiece); floating if broadcast
Size rule: Width: 25-40% of panel width; height: 1-3 lines
Shape & style: Rectangular with pixelated corners or scanline texture; fill cyan or green (#00ff88) 20% opacity; monospace font
Overlap rule: May overlap device screen or earpiece; clear association with technology
Layer priority: Same layer as standard speech; distinguish by tech texture
Prompt assembly rule: [message text] + [device type: phone / hologram / earpiece / screen] + [character's reaction to message: surprise / concern / relief]
Common failure: Tail points to character instead of device; indistinguishable from standard speech (reader misses tech context); font not monospace (breaks digital feel)
